messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — noticed a small billing spike in the overnight batch. Trace looks like reconnects + truncated toolcalls generating provisional then confirmed charges twice.
Alex Chen: logs: 
```
router=router-5 pod=ip-10-2-1-7 client=svc-frontend session=ses_48a1 toolcall_id=tc_9f2 start=1764249991 reconnect=1 truncated=true provisional_charge=45 confirmed_charge=45
```
Priya Patel: ugh. Is the confirmed charge appearing after the client replays the stream or because the toolcall TTL expires? any sessionid dedupe?
Jun Park: We currently mark provisional on stream chunk receipts then confirm on final ACK or ttl expiry. If reconnects re-send final ack, we might double-confirm unless dedupe keys match.
Maya R: Do we have client-provided toolcall_id trusted? Some SDKs re-gen ids on reconnects.
Sam G: SDKs try to reuse session/toolcall ids but older versions do not. We should guard server-side.
Lina Gomez: Quick mitigation: extend provisional grace-window from 5s -> 20s for affected tenants? That reduces chances of double-confirmation on flakey networks.
Priya Patel: That helps but hides root cause. We should also add router-level dedupe on (customer, session, toolcall_id) + sequence checksum before confirming.
Jun Park: Agree. Proposal: when provisional exists, confirmation requires either final chunk with matching seq or explicit confirm message. If we see reconnection with a different client_toolcall_id but same checksum, consider it a replay and skip confirm.
Alex Chen: We need telemetry first — count of: provisional_created, provisional_confirmed, provisional_expired, confirm_with_different_toolcall_id, confirm_skipped_by_dedupe.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-3221 for dedupe heuristic + dashboard panels https://infra/issues/INF-3221
Sam G: Console UX: show provisional line item on per-request trace and an ops toggle to aggregate provisional vs confirmed in billing view. That will help CS while we fix.
Maya R: Rollout plan: patch router to add dedupe header; canary to 10% hosts; flag default on for internal tenants, off for public until metrics look good.
Lina Gomez: Tests: add unit tests for resume flows + e2e with flaky socket that reconnects and resends final ack. Also fuzz toolcall ids.
Priya Patel: Also consider a short-term stopgap: if toolcall truncated=true + reconnect within 2s, suppress immediate confirmation until a short debounce window.
Jun Park: Implementation note: store provisional with (seq_checksum, prefix_len) to detect overlapping prefixes across reconnections — avoids false positives when clients legitimately use new toolcall ids.
Alex Chen: Ok — action items: Jun to draft router patch + telemetry events; Sam to mock console panel; Lina to add e2e tests; Priya to coordinate canary rollout. Ops ticket linked.
Sam G: I'll add a temporary dashboard: provisional->confirmed ratio by code path and by sdk version.
Maya R: FYI, alert on >0.5% double-confirm rate will block rollout.
Alex Chen: thanks all. I'll post a short note in incidents if we need a customer-facing explanation.
ops-bot: INF-3221 updated: assignees Jun Park, Sam G, Lina Gomez, Priya Patel. Priority: P2.
